thread:
Priya (CS): Hey team — customer 'ClipSnap' hitting duplicate completions + trimmed final sentence on SSE reconnects. They see repeated tokens and the last chunk cut off. Repro attached in ticket #3421 :eyes:

Jordan (Eng): thanks — can you paste the request payload and session id? what client lib/version?

Priya (CS): Uploaded logs + session id: sess_01GZ9xqHf in the ticket. Using node client v0.8.3. They do quick reconnect backoffs (~300ms) until resume succeeds. No idempotency key on reconnects. Noted latency spike before disconnect — p95 ~700ms.

Alex (Oncall): that pattern smells like overlapping delivery during resume. If the client reconnects before server finalizes, we might re-emit a chunk. @PlatformBot pull session traces for sess_01GZ9xqHf

PlatformBot: pulled logs for sess_01GZ9xqHf -> events: open, chunk seq=1, chunk seq=2, disconnect(code=1006), reconnect(resume_token=eyJ... rev=2), chunk seq=2, chunk seq=3(partial)

Jordan (Eng): yup — server re-emitted seq=2 after resume and client concatenated both -> duplicate tokens. Final chunk length shorter — looks like proxy closed mid-frame during reconnect and we replayed a truncated chunk.

Marta (Billing): customer says they were billed for the duplicate tokens. Can we confirm if duplicate generations were charged? They want a credit if so.

Priya (CS): repro I used locally (short):
```js
// node quick repro
const s = new SSE(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${KEY}` } });
// kill socket after receiving 2 chunks, reconnect with same resume token
```
I can share full script privately.

Jordan (Eng): request: can you get a minimal curl repro too? e.g.
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -d '{"input":"...","stream":true,"resume":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
# kill after chunk 2, reconnect reusing resume token
```
We should add sequence numbers to SSE payload so clients can dedupe.

Alex (Oncall): short-term mitigation: add server-side dedupe window keyed by (session_id, seq) for ~5s to swallow immediate replays. Also ensure finalization events only emitted after stream commit. I opened PR #2147 to surface seq meta and a small dedupe cache.

Jordan (Eng): noted. I'll run the reproducer against staging with the dedupe patch. If that removes duplicates we can roll to prod. Also need to audit our proxy for mid-frame closures.

Priya (CS): will offer customer client v0.8.4-beta (adds resume headers + optional seq dedupe) and ask them to test. Also asked them to hold billing until we confirm.

Sam (Client): we can reproduce reliably on our side, happy to test the beta. Also saw occasional 401 after long reconnect loops — suspect token rotation race.

Alex (Oncall): good catch. If token rotates during reconnect the resume attempt may 401 and client falls back to a fresh session -> duplicate generation + bill. Recommend clients refresh tokens proactively and attempt resume within token TTL. Added extra logging for token-mismatch events.

Jordan (Eng): follow-ups for engineering roadmap: (1) include seq numbers in SSE payload, (2) make resume-token issuance atomic with last-acked-seq, (3) implement short dedupe window for immediate replays, (4) proxy resilience fix for frame-truncation. Also create billing ticket to review any duplicates charged.

Marta (Billing): will hold credit assessment pending eng verification.

Priya (CS): I'll send the beta, repro, and next steps to the customer. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Alex (Oncall): great, keep me posted. If customer confirms duplicates gone on beta we can coordinate a small credit and schedule the prod rollout.

Jordan (Eng): tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform to pick this up.

Sam (Client): confirming I'll test today and paste results here.

Priya (CS): awesome — I'll update the ticket when we hear back.
